reason: Existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods remain insufficient in handling hallucination due to several underlying limitations. First, semantic vector-based retrieval may lead to the loss of critical information from the original text. Second, ambiguous queries can result in the retrieval of unhelpful content. Third, the single-round retrieval strategy cannot simulate the human reasoning process.
